name: Morphic
original_description: Create and edit images, video, and audio with Morphic's generation tools. Find projects, browse assets, preview results, and read saved workflow instructions in your connected Morphic workspace. An existing Morphic account is required. Available models and actions depend on your account permissions and entitlements. Generation and some media operations consume your account's credits; completion time depends on the selected model and task.

limitations_ja: 既存アカウントが必要。使用可能なモデルは権限によって異なり、生成や一部操作でクレジットを消費する。
